items.title: Ashley Keating and Allan Whitworth Interview, 1963-03-22
items.q: They spoke in terms of Lawrence Welk... but even though they did speak in terms of Lawrence Welk

ctx.x: Well, what about the band? What impressed you about it?

Uh, well, strangely, the, the, one thing that did, uh, impress, well, not actually impressed me, but struck me, was the, the fact that they all seemed very broad-minded musically. They spoke in terms of Lawrence Welk, um, various Dixieland bands, and the tunes they played, weren't perhaps, uh, Panama, uh, other New Orleans, uh, type tunes, or the ones that we in Australia think are typical New Orleans tunes, but rather, uh, a better quality of pop song. Uh, but even though they did speak in terms of Lawrence…
I wonder about, uh, the different people in the band. What did you think of them as individuals? If you don't mind answering them.
